answers.how: Measured the bow-to-stern extent, using the known motion and boat depths to calibrate scale and correct perspective foreshortening.
Measured across the boat perpendicular to its long axis and applied the depth-calibrated perspective scale.
Measured the vertical hull extent from the gunwale to the bottom and converted using the boat's depth.
Measured between the pier's long edges, correcting for its depth and foreshortening.
Measured from the shore-side edge to the outer edge and converted using the pier depth and perspective geometry.
Extrapolated the tracked boat motion to 3 seconds, then estimated the shortest perspective-corrected separation from the pier's outer edge.
Measured the steps from side to side and applied the scale at the supplied stairs depth.
Measured vertically from the pier deck to the waterline along the supporting posts and applied the pier-depth scale.
Measured the vertical floor-to-ground separation beneath the cabin and applied the scale at the stairs/cabin depth.
